page_title: MAI 2-0 HOF | Mainz v Hoffenheim 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) replaces Phillipp Mwene.
90+1' Here's the change. Jonathan Burkardt leaves the pitch and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' The attendance is 30000.
87' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Paul Nebel is replaced by Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz).
87' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
87' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.

86' What a great chance for Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
86' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) will take the corner.
82' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
82' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
79' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alexander Prass.
79' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Jacob Bruun Larsen and he is replaced by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim).
78' Poor challenge! Stefan Bell (Mainz) is penalised for tripping and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle.
74' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
73' Here is a change. Anthony Caci is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
69' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
68' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Haris Tabakovic will be replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
68' The substitution has been made. David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) has replaced Andrej Kramaric.
66' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Robin Zentner has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
64' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
62' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
55' The Mainz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
55' The referee blows his whistle as Stefan Bell (Mainz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
54' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Zentner comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' Paul Nebel (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
47' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Siebert had an easy-decision to make.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Christian Ilzer probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pavel Kaderabek. He is replaced by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but it's cleared.
40' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
39' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

39' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
37' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Siebert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
35' Stefan Bell (Mainz) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
34' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jonathan Burkardt, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
28' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Anthony Caci (Mainz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
24' 2 - 0 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) collects a good pass and slams the ball from mid-range into the top right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
19' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
17' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
16' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
16' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) brings his opponent down. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
11' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
11' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle as Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
8' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
7' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
7' Stefan Bell (Mainz) will take a corner kick.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Jae-Sung Lee provides Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.

3' Oliver Baumann was forced into action to thwart Dominik Kohr (Mainz). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
3' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' Flag goes up against Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will officiate today.
